intent.raw: Invoke Define and Design for the implementation-conformance package using all accepted research findings and suggestions.
intent.objective: Author and validate one bounded DomainSpec v2 implementation-conformance contract family without creating Plan, runtime, authority, promotion, or release evidence.
intent.operator_sentence: Define and design the new package; preserve all blind spots and owner boundaries.

technique_overlays.trigger: Normal Invoke Design requires exact scope extraction and unchanged two-pass concern selection.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The extractor and selector pass twice from identical immutable inputs and both replay artifacts are byte-identical.

technique_overlays.trigger: Adjacent package collisions needed one bounded read-only precedent audit.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The parent records the helper receipt, confirms no writes, and retains final synthesis authority.

subagent_strategy.trigger: One bounded read-only helper was used inside the parent route; no sibling fan-out, dependent waves, or reusable subagent graph was executed.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The helper supplied precedent evidence only. The parent owned scope, artifacts, validation, and final claims, so this route is not registered as a governed multi-agent dispatch.
context: Helper read scope was limited to adjacent package precedents.
Helper write scope was empty and its result is summarized in PRECEDENT-AUDIT.md.

steps.name: Build bounded Define and Design context
stop_conditions: stop if the accepted research claim ceiling or required owner evidence cannot be selected exactly

steps.name: Resolve reusable inventory and templates
stop_conditions: stop on invalid Inventory index or unresolved template tie

steps.name: Author Invoke Define and incorporate bounded precedent audit
stop_conditions: stop if the package duplicates semantic profile, code-tag, architecture-pattern, parser, derivation, exception, or authority ownership
stop if Define widens into Plan or implementation

steps.name: Extract the exact Design concern denominator
stop_conditions: stop on stale, missing, out-of-root, self-issued, unknown, or unbound Design input

steps.name: Select Design outputs through an unchanged two-pass validator
stop_conditions: stop unless the result is total, owner-complete, fixed-point, and design-validator-pass

steps.name: Author the six-view architecture and selected extensions
stop_conditions: stop if a non-required companion output is selected
stop if Design creates work-pack tasks or claims product evidence

steps.name: Distill the smallest coherent design unit
stop_conditions: do not route to normal Plan when Distill flags or blocks unresolved owner or recomposition tension

steps.name: Record child and parent observability and close Invoke
stop_conditions: record observability residue without changing the Design verdict if telemetry append fails

gates.condition: All Define obligations have exact selected evidence and the claim ceiling is explicit.
Define owns only implementation-facing contracts and routes every adjacent authority outward.
The Design scope is schema-valid, digest-current, selector-closed, independently authored, and has no unknowns.
Every denominator signal binds to one owner-complete concern and pass one equals pass two.
Six views, required extensions, source contracts, glossary check, witnesses, risks, and claim limits exist without Plan artifacts.
The coherent unit, recomposition, split pressure, and unresolved owner gates are explicit; flag prevents normal Plan handoff.
No authored or generated artifact claims semantic admission, exception acceptance, promotion, deployment, release, or production readiness.

native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Design may consume Define; Plan may not infer owner closure.
Selection may consume only this exact receipt.

native_stage_receipts.residue: rollout and performance recommended; security persistence UX N/A
five owner closures prevent normal Plan handoff
native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Route to deferred owner-gated Define/Design follow-up.

boundaries.contract: Read adjacent precedents, make no writes, and return collision/owner findings; parent owns all authored conclusions.
Admission, edge policy, code-tag reformulation, exceptions, data policy, implementation host, promotion, and release remain outside Invoke authoring authority.

promotion_guardrails: Inventory lookup and CAV2 source proximity do not promote package terms or patterns.
Design validator pass is Design evidence only; Plan and product evidence are separate.
The bounded helper receipt is parent evidence, not a governed multi-agent dispatch registration.
No receipt authorizes semantic admission, exception acceptance, implementation, promotion, deployment, release, or production readiness.
